provider_relative_volume.note: Today's provider volume against its own trailing mean -- a ratio within one series, so an unknown constant composition cancels.

provider_volume_anomaly_detection.note: Outliers *within the same provider series*. Cross-provider anomaly detection is not this capability.

provider_volume_history_display.note: Showing the retained daily volume series as the provider reported it.

provider_volume_moving_average.note: A mean over the same provider series. Same composition on both sides.

provider_volume_trend_indicator.note: Direction of the provider series over time, not a claim about market share.

research_only_volume_technical_indicator.note: OBV, MFI, Chaikin and similar, whose interpretation is a shape in one series and does not require knowing the market's complete composition. Research scope: they may not be presented as a liquidity or executability finding.

source_labeled_volume_comparison.note: Comparison that names VCI as the source in the output, not in a footnote.

turnover_tier_screening_score.note: Coarse close x volume banding used to rank screening candidates. Retained because it is a relative screen over one provider series, not a tradable-size estimate; it must never be labelled or exported as qualified market liquidity.

volume_based_ranking_or_recommendation.note: Ranking or recommending on volume presented as qualified market liquidity.
